::: {.kk-intro}
**Research updates, field notes, and the people behind the science.**

Kelp Korner is the quarterly newsletter of the Nearshore Ecology Research Group at UC Santa Cruz. Explore new discoveries, follow fieldwork along California's coast, and get to know the researchers and students doing the work.
:::

## Latest issues

Our first issue is in preparation. New quarterly editions will appear below as they're published.
